payload_json.title: Classify rejection provenance in event-sourced state
payload_json.description: Add validated `quality`, `evidence_resubmission`, and `process` rejection categories; default omitted/historical values to quality.

scores.explanation:
complexity: 4 (base 4 (>=5 files))
parallelizability: 1 (in >=2 conflict groups)
context_load: 4 (files span 4 directories)
blast_radius: 5 (base 5 (schema/migration/config/settings file), +1 (public API surface: cli.py / mcp_server.py / __init__.py))
review_risk: 4 (base 2, +1 (schema or migration file), +1 (CLI/MCP public surface))
agent_suitability: 2 (6 - complexity(4) = 2, capped at 2 (blast_radius=5 >= 4))

acceptance_criteria: CLI/MCP persist immutable engine-derived category, enumerated reason code, reviewer actor, claim/review-attempt identity, supporting evidence digest, typed quality findings, and matched process predicate; invalid input fails before mutation and callers never select the category.

`evidence_resubmission` is derived only when the persisted typed-evidence gate is incomplete and the typed quality-finding set is empty. `process` is derived only when a persisted engine-observed process predicate matches its reason code. Reviewer identity is attribution only and is never an eligibility input. A caller-supplied or changed reviewer actor cannot promote a rejection to a non-quality category because only persisted typed-evidence state or a matched engine-observed process predicate determines eligibility. Free text, reviewer assertion, missing typed findings, falsified reason codes, disagreement, omission, or ambiguity defaults to `quality`.
Historical uncategorized review rows/events migrate and replay as quality, and the migrated SQLite projection equals event replay.
Only quality contributes to accept-rate and escalation calculations.
Apply output reports whether the rejection counts and projected metrics.
Claim owners cannot reclassify or replay a rejection to improve metrics.
Before allocating a migration version, this task rebases onto the merged provider-read-contracts milestone and uses the next compatible schema version.
